name: Raspberry Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: soft bread crumbs
ingredients.originalText: six cupfuls of soft bread crumbs

instructions.text: Rub the butter and sugar together
Beat the eggs, yolks and whites separately
Mash the raspberries, add the whites beaten to a stiff froth
Stir all together to a smooth paste
Butter a pudding dish, cover the bottom with a layer of the crumbs, then a layer of the mixture
Continue the alternate layers until the dish is full, making the last layer of crumbs
Bake one hour in a moderate oven
Serve in the dish in which it is baked and serve with fruit sauce made with raspberries

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Rub the butter and sugar together
2. Beat the eggs, yolks and whites separately
3. Mash the raspberries, add the whites beaten to a stiff froth
4. Stir all together to a smooth paste
5. Butter a pudding dish, cover the bottom with a layer of the crumbs, then a layer of the mixture
6. Continue the alternate layers until the dish is full, making the last layer of crumbs
7. Bake one hour in a moderate oven
8. Serve in the dish in which it is baked and serve with fruit sauce made with raspberries
